summary: Most new tech money is still AI infrastructure: about $725B of 2026 hyperscaler capex, with the fastest growth now in inference chips (Broadcom AI chip revenue up 221% y/y) and the parts that are sold out, namely advanced packaging and optics. Quantum computing moved from venture money to government money in 2026, when Commerce took equity stakes in nine firms, but revenue is still tiny. Edge AI devices ship in volume (AI PCs are over half of 2026 PC shipments) yet people rarely use the on-device AI, so that money is weaker than it looks.

innovations.name: AI inference chips and custom accelerators
innovations.what: Chips built to run AI models after they are trained (inference), either custom chips designed for one cloud company or specialized chips like Cerebras wafers. Inference is where AI spending turns into daily usage and recurring revenue.
innovations.stage_why: Custom accelerators are now a large, fast-growing business: Broadcom AI chip revenue hit $16.7B in the quarter ended Aug 2, 2026. NVIDIA GPUs still run most inference, so specialized chips are real but not yet the default.

evidence.cost: Silicon Data's LLM token price index hit a record low of about $0.97 per million tokens in early September 2026, after a 43% drop from $2.04 at end of May to about $1.17 in early August 2026. Cheaper tokens drive more usage, which needs more inference chips.
evidence.approvals: US export controls still gate China sales; BIS moved H200-class chips to case-by-case review on Jan 13, 2026.
evidence.money: Big 4 hyperscalers plan about $725B of 2026 capex. Anthropic's compute commitments were reported at $518B, including $161.2B to Broadcom (reported, 2026). OpenAI agreed to deploy 750 MW of Cerebras inference compute over several years.
evidence.revenue: Broadcom Q3 FY2026 (ended Aug 2, 2026) AI semiconductor revenue $16.7B, up 221% y/y, with a Q4 guide of $21.7B. Cerebras Q2 2026 core revenue $209.9M, up 103% y/y, cloud up 287%, with $25.4B of remaining performance obligations. Anthropic run rate reported above $65B at end of July 2026 and OpenAI above $40B in August 2026 (reported).

spreads_to.use: Cheap inference makes AI scribes, imaging reads and prior authorization bots affordable at scale.
Real time fraud scoring and AI underwriting run on inference capacity.
Agents that run many model calls per task make inference cost the main cost of goods for software companies.

innovations.bottleneck: TSMC leading-edge wafers and CoWoS packaging plus HBM memory. TSMC, SK hynix, Samsung and Micron control them, and NVIDIA booked about 60% of 2026 CoWoS.

next_milestone.event: Broadcom Q4 FY2026 results (guide $21.7B AI revenue) and Cerebras Q3 results

innovations.thesis_broken_if: Hyperscaler 2027 capex guides come in flat or down while token prices keep falling, which would mean usage is not growing fast enough to pay for the chips.

innovations.name: Quantum computing
innovations.what: Computers that use quantum bits to solve certain chemistry, materials and optimization problems that normal computers cannot. Useful machines need error correction, which is still being built.
innovations.stage_why: Real systems are sold to governments, labs and a few companies, but no one has shown a broad commercial advantage yet. IBM's own target for a large fault-tolerant machine is 2029, and DARPA's benchmark program runs to 2033.

evidence.approvals: DARPA Quantum Benchmarking Initiative moved IBM and others to Stage B (of three) in 2026; the program tests whether a useful fault-tolerant computer can be built by 2033.
evidence.money: May 21, 2026: Commerce signed letters of intent for $2.013B of CHIPS Act incentives to nine quantum firms in exchange for minority equity stakes: IBM $1B, GlobalFoundries $375M, Atom Computing, D-Wave, Infleqtion, PsiQuantum and Quantinuum $100M each, Rigetti up to $100M, Diraq $38M. IBM committed more than $10B to quantum over five years (June 2, 2026). Quantinuum IPO'd in June 2026 at about a $12.7B valuation.
evidence.revenue: IonQ Q2 2026 revenue $80.1M, up 287% y/y, full year guide raised to $280M to $290M (excludes SkyWater, which it acquired). Rigetti Q1 2026 revenue $4.4M. D-Wave Q2 2026 revenue $3.1M, though Q1 bookings were $33.4M.

spreads_to.use: Molecule and protein simulation for drug discovery, once error-corrected machines exist.
Battery chemistry, catalysts and fertilizer process design.
Portfolio optimization pilots now; the bigger effect is forcing a shift to post-quantum encryption.

innovations.bottleneck: Error correction and qubit quality, plus specialty supply: dilution refrigerators, lasers, and quantum-grade foundry capacity (IBM and GlobalFoundries are building US quantum foundries with Commerce money).

next_milestone.event: IBM demonstration of scientific quantum advantage and a fault-tolerant module, as promised for 2026

innovations.thesis_broken_if: IBM misses its 2026 advantage and fault-tolerant module goals and DARPA cuts teams at the next stage, which would push useful machines well past 2030.

innovations.name: Photonics and co-packaged optics
innovations.what: Moving data with light instead of copper inside and between AI racks. Co-packaged optics (CPO) puts the optical engine right next to the switch chip, which cuts power and allows bigger GPU clusters.
innovations.stage_why: Pluggable optical transceivers are already mass market in AI data centers. CPO itself is just starting: NVIDIA's Spectrum-X and Quantum-X Photonics switches roll out in 2026, but meaningful scale-up CPO volume is expected only in late 2027 to 2028.

evidence.money: NVIDIA invested $2B each in Lumentum and Coherent in March 2026, tied to multi-billion-dollar laser purchase commitments. Corning signed fiber deals with Meta (up to $6B), NVIDIA (up to $3.2B) and Amazon in 2026.
evidence.revenue: Ethernet optical transceiver plus CPO sales for AI clusters were estimated at $16.5B in 2025 and $26B in 2026, up 60% (industry research cited by Lightwave, 2026). Corning Optical Communications Q1 2026 sales $1.85B, up 36%. IDTechEx projects the CPO market above $20B by 2036.

spreads_to.use: The same lasers and coherent optics carry traffic between data centers and in telecom networks.
Silicon photonics is used in optical biosensors and imaging (OCT); a small side market.
Lidar and in-vehicle optical links reuse photonics supply chains.

innovations.bottleneck: Indium phosphide lasers (EML and CW) and fiber. Lumentum and Coherent dominate lasers, Corning dominates fiber, and TSMC's COUPE packaging is needed for NVIDIA CPO.

next_milestone.event: Volume shipments of NVIDIA Spectrum-X Photonics CPO switches and first scale-up CPO orders

innovations.thesis_broken_if: Copper (active electrical cables) keeps winning short links in Rubin and Kyber racks and CPO volume slips past 2028.

innovations.name: Advanced packaging (CoWoS, hybrid bonding, panel level)
innovations.what: Stitching GPU dies and stacks of HBM memory together on one package so they act like one giant chip. Packaging, not chip making, has become the main limit on how many AI accelerators can ship.
innovations.stage_why: CoWoS-type packaging is in essentially every AI accelerator and runs at about 127,000 to 130,000 wafers a month by end of 2026. The next steps (hybrid bonding, panel level CoPoS, glass substrates) are still pilot, with CoPoS mass production expected 2028 to 2029.

evidence.cost: Ajinomoto is raising ABF film prices as the substrate supply gap extends into 2027, and T-glass cloth stays short until new capacity in 2027 to 2028.
evidence.money: TSMC CoWoS capacity is expected to reach about 170,000 wafers per month by end of 2027 (KGI, Sep 2026) and could double to about 260,000 by 2028. TSMC is outsourcing some CoWoS steps to OSATs (Aug 2026). NVIDIA booked an estimated 60% of 2026 CoWoS capacity.
evidence.revenue: TSMC August 2026 revenue NT$514.8B, up 53.3% y/y. Besi Q1 2026 orders EUR 269.7M, more than double y/y on hybrid bonding. Applied Materials and Besi got a first hybrid bonding volume order from SK hynix in March 2026.

spreads_to.use: Chiplets and 3D stacking move into phone and PC processors.
Co-packaged optics depends on the same packaging lines.
Chiplet packaging for self-driving computers and radar processors.

innovations.bottleneck: TSMC CoWoS capacity and a few Japanese materials: Ajinomoto ABF film, Nittobo T-glass, Ibiden substrates. All are sold out into 2027.

next_milestone.event: TSMC Q3 2026 earnings call update on CoWoS and Arizona packaging capacity

innovations.thesis_broken_if: Packaging lead times shorten and substrate prices fall while AI chip orders flatten, meaning capacity caught up with demand.

innovations.name: Edge AI devices (AI PCs, AI phones, smart glasses)
innovations.what: Phones, laptops and glasses with a built-in AI chip (NPU) that runs models on the device instead of the cloud. That means faster, more private and cheaper AI for simple tasks.
innovations.stage_why: AI PCs are now over half of PC shipments, but mostly because every new chip has an NPU, not because buyers demand it, and on-device AI features see little use. AI glasses are growing fast from a small base, almost all Meta.

evidence.cost: High memory prices in 2026 are raising device costs; the PC market is expected to shrink by as much as 9% in 2026 even as AI PC share rises.
evidence.money: Meta keeps funding Reality Labs and dominates AI glasses (about 84% of global smart glasses shipments in H1 2026). Qualcomm's Snapdragon X2 PC platform (NPU up to 85 TOPS) is in mass production in 2026.
evidence.revenue: Gartner forecasts 143.1M AI PCs in 2026, 54.7% of PC shipments. AI glasses shipments rose 263% y/y in H1 2026 (Counterpoint). TrendForce sees AR glasses at 950,000 units in 2026, up 53%. Qualcomm fiscal Q1 2026 revenue was $12.3B, up only 5% y/y, with memory costs a headwind, so the AI device story has not yet lifted its sales much.

spreads_to.use: Smart glasses and on-device AI for hands-free documentation, hearing assist and vision aid.
Field technicians use glasses for guided repair and inspection.
The same NPUs run driver assistance and in-car assistants.

innovations.bottleneck: DRAM supply (AI servers are absorbing memory, raising device costs) and a killer app that makes people pay for on-device AI.

next_milestone.event: Holiday 2026 sales of AI glasses and AI PCs; Meta and Qualcomm Q3 reports

innovations.thesis_broken_if: AI glasses sales growth stalls in holiday 2026 and PC makers drop AI marketing as unit volumes fall.
